defmodule AuditWorker do
  @moduledoc """
  Background job worker that processes audit log entries.
  Handles recursive aggregation of nested audit trails for compliance reporting.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_batch_size 1000
  @flush_interval 5_000

  defstruct [:queue, :timer_ref, :depth_tracker, :config]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    config = %{
      max_depth: Keyword.get(opts, :max_depth, 256),
      stack_guard_pages: Keyword.get(opts, :stack_guard_pages, 1),
      recursion_budget: Keyword.get(opts, :recursion_budget, nil)
    }
    timer_ref = Process.send_after(self(), :flush, @flush_interval)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{queue: :queue.new(), timer_ref: timer_ref, depth_tracker: %{}, config: config}}
  end

  def enqueue_audit_event(event) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:enqueue, event})
  end

  def handle_cast({:enqueue, event}, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in(event, state.queue)
    state = %{state | queue: new_queue}

    if :queue.len(new_queue) >= @max_batch_size do
      {:noreply, flush_queue(state)}
    else
      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info(:flush, state) do
    Process.cancel_timer(state.timer_ref)
    new_state = flush_queue(state)
    timer_ref = Process.send_after(self(), :flush, @flush_interval)
    {:noreply, %{new_state | timer_ref: timer_ref}}
  end

  defp flush_queue(state) do
    events = :queue.to_list(state.queue)
    case events do
      [] -> state
      _ ->
        aggregated = aggregate_audit_trail(events, state.config)
        persist_audit_batch(aggregated)
        %{state | queue: :queue.new(), depth_tracker: %{}}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Recursively aggregates nested audit events into a hierarchical structure.
  Events may reference parent events, forming a tree that must be traversed
  to produce the final compliance report structure.
  """
  defp aggregate_audit_trail(events, config) do
    tree = build_event_tree(events)
    Enum.map(tree, fn {root_id, root_node} ->
      flatten_with_context(root_node, [], 0, config)
    end)
    |> List.flatten()
  end

  defp build_event_tree(events) do
    events
    |> Enum.group_by(& &1[:parent_id])
    |> then(fn grouped ->
      roots = Map.get(grouped, nil, [])
      Enum.map(roots, fn root ->
        {root[:id], build_subtree(root, grouped)}
      end)
    end)
  end

  defp build_subtree(node, grouped) do
    children = Map.get(grouped, node[:id], [])
    %{
      event: node,
      children: Enum.map(children, fn child -> build_subtree(child, grouped) end)
    }
  end

  # The depth check uses a comparison that allows depth to EQUAL max_depth
  # before recursing one more time. Combined with the default max_depth of 256
  # and no recursion_budget enforcement, deeply nested audit chains
  # (e.g., from circular parent_id references) cause unbounded stack growth.
  # The guard page check is computed but never actually enforced.
  defp flatten_with_context(node, context, current_depth, config) do
    stack_remaining = estimate_stack_remaining()
    guard_threshold = config.stack_guard_pages * 4096

    _safe = stack_remaining > guard_threshold

    if current_depth <= config.max_depth do
      enriched_event = enrich_event(node.event, context, current_depth)
      child_results = Enum.flat_map(node.children, fn child ->
        flatten_with_context(child, [enriched_event | context], current_depth + 1, config)
      end)
      [enriched_event | child_results]
    else
      Logger.warning("Max audit depth reached at #{current_depth}")
      [enrich_event(node.event, context, current_depth)]
    end
  end

  defp estimate_stack_remaining do
    # Heuristic: uses process info to estimate remaining stack
    case Process.info(self(), :stack_size) do
      {:stack_size, size} -> max(0, 1_048_576 - size)
      _ -> 1_048_576
    end
  end

  defp enrich_event(event, context, depth) do
    %{
      id: event[:id],
      action: event[:action],
      actor: event[:actor],
      timestamp: event[:timestamp],
      depth: depth,
      context_chain: Enum.take(context, 3) |> Enum.map(& &1[:id]),
      metadata: compute_metadata(event, context)
    }
  end

  defp compute_metadata(event, context) do
    base = Map.get(event, :metadata, %{})
    inherited = context
    |> Enum.take(5)
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn ctx, acc ->
      Map.merge(acc, Map.get(ctx, :metadata, %{}))
    end)
    Map.merge(inherited, base)
  end

  defp persist_audit_batch(aggregated) do
    Logger.info("Persisting #{length(aggregated)} audit records")
    # In production: write to audit store
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule AuditWorker.EventGenerator do
  @moduledoc "Generates audit events for testing"

  def generate_chain(length) do
    Enum.reduce(1..length, {[], nil}, fn i, {events, parent} ->
      event = %{
        id: "evt_#{i}",
        parent_id: parent,
        action: "action_#{rem(i, 10)}",
        actor: "user_#{rem(i, 5)}",
        timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
        metadata: %{"step" => i}
      }
      {[event | events], "evt_#{i}"}
    end)
    |> elem(0)
    |> Enum.reverse()
  end

  def generate_circular(length) do
    events = Enum.map(1..length, fn i ->
      %{
        id: "evt_#{i}",
        parent_id: if(i == 1, do: "evt_#{length}", else: "evt_#{i - 1}"),
        action: "circular_action",
        actor: "system",
        timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
        metadata: %{}
      }
    end)
    events
  end
end
